title: Directorium Core — traditional Roman liturgical-calendar engine and CC0 dataset
description: A clean-room engine that computes the traditional Roman liturgical calendar (the 1954 Divino Afflatu, 1955 interim, and 1962 Rubricae 1960 editions) and generates a cited, independently oracle-validated, byte-reproducible corpus. Each release attaches the compiled dataset as a versioned CC0 artifact with a SHA-256 manifest. This archive is the versioned source that produces it.
notes: The engine and source are AGPL-3.0-or-later; the compiled dataset attached to each release is dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0 (see the dataset's own LICENSE.txt).
